'I'll Find You Where the Timeline Ends' is a young adult romantic fantasy novel by American author Kylie Lee Baker. It was published by Feiwel & Friends on November 18, 2025. An audiobook narrated by Mirai Mirai was released concurrently with the hardbook and ebook editions.
Synopsis
Descended from Ryūjin, Yang Mina was born with the ability to travel through time, and has spent her life training to become a member of the Descendants, a secret organization of other descendants of Japanese and Korean dragon gods, whose purpose is to alter events to protect the true timeline. As an eighteen-year-old American exchange student in Seoul, she wants a boy in her calculus class to kiss her so that she can gain infiltration points, which would help her get promoted to associate agent. With the promotion, she could get a permanent job in South Korea rather than continue moving between Korea and Japan with her parents. When she learns that she has a sister named Hana who has been erased from existence, she decides that she must find her. When Mina means Kim Yejun, a rogue agent who has also lost someone, she decides to work with him to fix the timeline, defying the Descendants' code.
Reception
Kirkus Reviews called it a "charming love story" with "intricate worldbuilding", but noted that "the complex explanations of time travel and the butterfly principle can be confusing at first". Elizabeth Kahn of School Library Journal criticized the time travel and romance for being "repetitive". Publishers Weekly praised Mina and Yejun's chemistry and the novel's "evocative" descriptions of Seoul. In his review for FanFiAddict, Will Swardstrom stated that he "had a lot of fun" with the novel's time loops and praised Baker for tying everything up "fairly neatly".
